subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for both the sanitizer gap and the native Vertex ADC/gaxios auth-stack crash, or should maintainers split the auth-stack path into a separate canonical issue now?
rationale: Current main still misses the sanitizer fix, while latest-release user evidence and dependency inspection support a separate auth-stack path whose permanent fix shape needs maintainer ownership.

options.title: Keep This Canonical
options.body: Keep the issue open until both slices are resolved or one is explicitly split to a durable follow-up.

options.title: Split Auth Stack
options.body: Designate a separate auth-stack issue for service-account ADC/gaxios/node-fetch/domexception before closing this issue after sanitizer verification.

recommendation.title: Keep This Canonical
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until both slices are resolved or one is explicitly split to a durable follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses SDK helper behavior, provider auth, dependency policy, and issue split or close direction.
